title: Read the east road beyond GSC-0044 and Intercrus for its sites: Nembus, Cervantes, Oakridge, Miaplacidus, Aldhibah, Tidewater, Ross 154 and the systems between, every three hours
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 23:23 UTC for orders.log ENT-052 (block ORACLE, P4 b): name the candidates of the east (beyond GSC-0044 and Intercrus) with their fields, lanes and pirate record (rule F33: a station about 4 systems beyond the outpost, an outpost about 4 beyond the station). The list: the lawless systems whose shortest way from our space runs through GSC-0044 or Intercrus, 1 to 8 jumps beyond them, west of the Dross pirate group around Hollowcrest, Merak, Sheliak and Titawin (table lanes, observations kind pirate), taken from census-roads so that no system stands on two lists of ours. Every 150 minutes, so that a read is under three hours old (a threshold is the floor of a gap), `chain` 3 within two lanes; three explorers. An empty hold (rule F13); a pirate met is filed for Military, the scout reads and leaves (rule F27). 2026-11-22 23:30 UTC (Oracle, orders ENT-068: newborn regions first, then the census burn cut by a third, the lists the plans rest on kept closest): every_minutes 150 -> 170, max_ships 3 -> 2. 2026-11-22 23:40 UTC (Oracle): every_minutes 170 -> 170, max_ships 2 -> 3: the caps of 23:30 UTC taken back, since a scout they leave docked has no work rule F8 counts as operating (Unity, requests ENT-373, ENT-374: the loop keeps the rest until such work stands); the census cut waits for that work (requests.log).
